name: of_injective
statement: ∀ i j hij, Function.Injective (f' i j hij)) (i) : Function.Injective (of G (fun i j h ↦ f' i j h) i)

name: map
statement: (i : ι) → G i →+* G' i) (hg : ∀ i j h, (g j).comp (f i j h) = (f' i j h).comp (g i)) : DirectLimit G (fun _ _ h ↦ f _ _ h) →+* DirectLimit G' fun _ _ h ↦ f' _ _ h

name: congr
statement: (i : ι) → G i ≃+* G' i) (he : ∀ i j h, (e j).toRingHom.comp (f i j h) = (f' i j h).comp (e i)) : DirectLimit G (fun _ _ h ↦ f _ _ h) ≃+* DirectLimit G' fun _ _ h ↦ f' _ _ h
